# LiquidGlass 1.0.3

This is the browser ESM bundle from `@ybouane/liquidglass@1.0.3`, with its source map comment removed. Upstream declares MIT and bundles `html-to-image` 1.11.13. [Upstream license declaration](https://github.com/ybouane/liquidglass#license) · [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ybouane/liquidglass/v/1.0.3)

The PoC serves the fixed bundle locally. The package runs `patch-package` during installation and lists it as a development dependency.
